set.body:
Objective

Make a rectangular form between two named effect spaces the universal query and result contract while retaining symmetric geometry as the optimized self-case.

Primary ownership

R/effect-space.R, R/scope.R, R/result.R, R/storage.R, associated documentation and tests.

Deliverables

- pair_query(H, left_space, right_space) with independent named-axis validation.
- bilinear_query() as the symmetric same-space compatibility constructor.
- One logical effect-form result carrying left/right spaces, logical shape, storage codec, capabilities, metadata, and receipt.
- Symmetric-packed and rectangular in-memory/block-backed codecs.
- Strict separation between complete forms and query-only effect_view results.
- Capability guards for RDM, RSA, spectrum, configuration, and later normalized views.

Acceptance

Packed and rectangular representations contract identically for symmetric forms; independent left/right permutations are equivariant; swapped or merely same-shaped axes fail; complete versus query-only claims cannot be forged; current result/storage/query tests remain green.

Non-goals

No two-relation execution or normalized-edge implementation yet.
set.title: Generalize axis-bound queries and effect-form result storage
